layout.toggleSidebar: Show or hide the side bar
layout.togglePanel: Show or hide the work panel
layout.focusNext: Move the focus to the next area
layout.focusPrev: Move the focus to the previous area

chat.scrollTop: Go to the start of the chat
chat.scrollBottom: Go to the end of the chat

sidebar.up: Move up in the side bar
sidebar.down: Move down in the side bar
sidebar.activate: Open the scenario or fold the section

overlay.close: Close the palette or the help

input.left: Move the cursor one character left
input.right: Move the cursor one character right
input.wordLeft: Move the cursor one word left
input.wordRight: Move the cursor one word right
input.lineStart: Go to the start of the line
input.lineEnd: Go to the end of the line
input.up: Line up, or the previous message of the history
input.down: Line down, or the next message of the history
input.backspace: Delete the character before the cursor
input.delete: Delete the character at the cursor
input.killToEnd: Cut from the cursor to the end of the line
input.killToStart: Cut from the cursor to the start of the line
input.killWordBack: Cut the word before the cursor
input.killWordForward: Cut the word after the cursor
input.externalEditor: Write the message in the external editor
input.pasteImage: Attach the image on the clipboard

settings.login: Sign in to the account (official login)
settings.edit: Change the value or the rule
settings.unset: Take the key out (back to the default)
settings.scope: Switch between the global and the project scope

errors.invalidCombo: "{{combo}}" is not a valid key combination (action {{action}}).
errors.duplicate: The shortcut {{combo}} is used by "{{action}}" and by "{{other}}".

terminal.cmd: {{combo}} cannot be used in the terminal: it does not send the Cmd key (action {{action}}).
terminal.ctrl_shift_letter: {{combo}} cannot be used in the terminal: Ctrl+Shift+letter reaches the program as Ctrl+letter (action {{action}}).
terminal.bare_printable: {{combo}} cannot be a global shortcut: it would take a character from the text box (action {{action}}).

notices.tmuxPrefix: {{combo}} ("{{action}}") is the default prefix of tmux: press it twice or change the shortcut.
notices.vscodeCapture: {{combo}} ("{{action}}") may be taken by VS Code before it reaches the terminal.
notices.macOption: On macOS, the Alt shortcuts use the Option key: turn on "Use Option as Meta" in the terminal.
notices.macFn: On macOS, the function keys may need the Fn key.

reasons.readline: it is an editing key of the text box and of the shell
reasons.wordJump: it jumps between words in the text box
reasons.flowControl: some terminals use it to pause the output
reasons.tmuxPrefix: it is the prefix of tmux
reasons.browserTab: the browser uses it to close a tab
reasons.terminalAlias: the terminal sends the same code as another key

app.title: OTheater
app.crash: The TUI stopped on an error: {{message}}

patch.version_mismatch: The render patches are off: Ink {{version}} is installed and they are only for Ink {{supported}}.
patch.ink_not_found: The render patches are off: the version of Ink could not be read.
patch.hook_unavailable: The render patches are off: this Node cannot load the module hook.

status.heading: Daemon
status.offline: No daemon is running. Start it with "ot daemon" in another terminal.
status.failed: Could not connect to the daemon: {{message}}

chat.title: Chat
chat.inputHint: The text box arrives with the chat step.

panel.empty: This tab has no content yet.
panel.noTabs: No tab open. Add one to fill the panel.

status.noImage: There is no image on the clipboard.
status.toolMissing: To paste an image, install one of: {{tools}}.
status.imageTooBig: The image is larger than the limit of {{limit}} MB (ui.input.image.maxBytes).
status.editorMissing: Set the variable VISUAL or EDITOR to write in an editor.
status.readingImage: Reading the image from the clipboard...
status.historyFailed: The history could not be saved: {{message}}

prompt.apiKey: API key of {{profile}} (kept in the vault, never shown)
prompt.confirmRemove: Remove {{profile}}? Its sessions drain, then its directory and key go. y/n
prompt.hintConfirm: y confirms, any other key cancels

login.title: Sign in: {{profile}}

mode.browser: Open the address in a browser and sign in.
mode.device_code: Open the address and type the code there.

login.noUrl: The client has not printed an address yet.
login.takesCode: Paste the code the browser shows here. Enter sends it, Esc cancels.
login.waiting: Waiting for the sign-in to end...
login.terminal: This client signs in at the terminal: {{command}}
login.terminalDone: The terminal sign-in of {{profile}} ended with code {{code}}.
login.terminalFailed: The terminal sign-in could not run: {{message}}

reason.refused: the client ended without a login

result.readOnly: The project scope is read only: no route writes the override of a project.
result.badWhole: {{key}} takes a whole number, {{min}} or more.
result.badDuration: {{key}} takes a duration such as 30m, 2h or 45s.
result.noLogin: Only a subscription account signs in.
